options.label: Does the enemy currently have an Ignite from Beira's Anguish?
options.tooltip: Declare an already-established ground Ignite after Flammability reached 50%. Equipping or enabling the charm does not establish an Ignite. Uses current maximum Life as the creation snapshot. Ordinary ignites use the strongest source, not their sum. Mixed-source multi-Ignite stacking is shown separately and not added to the total. No automatic use frequency, buildup time, expiry or uptime.
